body:
The new #1005 regression module currently fails in the repository's maintained hermetic test environment because its transaction cases unconditionally require the sibling Claw package `kg_microbe_write`.

`.github/workflows/tests.yaml` installs the MIM runtime plus pytest/pytest-cov and does not install or check out Claw. The established native integration fixture in `tests/test_merge_carnitine_hydrochloride.py` explicitly declares this optional dependency. The new `tests/test_curate_lithium_glycerophosphate.py` has no corresponding boundary.

Reproduction at the new module SHA256 `914f25060dfb2de935466925b82fc8f760e93f0ca168d07f825e35c47c1fa319`: run the maintained Python 3.13 environment with only `PYTHONPATH=src:.`, confirm `importlib.util.find_spec('kg_microbe_write')` returns `None`, then run this module with `--maxfail=1`. Two pure checks pass; the first transaction case fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'kg_microbe_write'` in the native publisher. Log: `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/step4-independent/lithium-without-claw-runtime.log`, SHA256 `6a4554bdbd6b18c09735eb7592accc78c19cc94e4664bf4464b1844a11eecc23`.

Severity: low, predictable CI failure. Keep pure scientific/provenance transformation checks active in the hermetic tier, declare the native integration dependency only on cases that really need it, and retain actual native execution in the local independent validation. Add a hermetic regression/control run and rerun all native tests. Do not replace the real publisher with a fake transaction or blanket-skip the whole module. No workflow or dependency-install change is requested, particularly no change to the protected evidence workflow.
title: Separate pure lithium regressions from optional Claw integration tests
